clarity.notes: All-sessions view now reads as an index: sticky 28px agent headers with neutral initials chips and bare mono counts, hairline dividers between groups, one-line session rows with title + relative time. Status is carried by the dot shapes; the repeated colored state words are gone.

hierarchy.notes: Group header (11.5px/500 name, faint count, chevron) sits below session titles (12px fg) in weight of attention; indentation aligns row titles to the header name x-position (33px). Accent appears only on the current-session bar and running dot.

typography.notes: Compact scale holds the token stack: 11.5px header, 12px row title, 9px mono time/count. No display faces, no new sizes outside the existing ramp.

motion.notes: Collapse is a 200ms grid-template-rows ease-out with visibility handoff, chevron rotates in 140ms; both are killed by the global prefers-reduced-motion guard. Root cause of the dead toggle (author .session-list display beating UA [hidden]) replaced by data-collapsed state.

brand.notes: Decorative nth-of-type avatar tints (success/warning/info) removed — agent chips use elevated+muted like event avatars and workspace marks; signal palette is back to state-only. Collapsed groups persist to localStorage like the rail state.
